{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Count QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = loyal_completed[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
num_qa = len(qa_orders)

# Filter out QA orders
real_orders = loyal_completed[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]
num_real = len(real_orders)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = real_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {num_qa}')
print(f'Number of real completed orders from loyal customers: {num_real}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}')"}
